story.iWant: a unified effects control panel in my editor
story.soThat: I can easily discover and customize all visual effects in one place
story.tasks: - Add animation_intensity column to database - Update shared schema - Create EffectsPanel component with accordion structure - Implement Button Effects section (hover, glow, gradient border, glass) - Implement Title Effects section (gradient text, glow, shadow) - Implement Background Effects section (animated gradient, particles) - Add Animation Intensity global control - Implement Reset Effects button - Integrate EffectsPanel into DesignTab - Create CSS variables for intensity levels

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: AC1: Effects section visible in Design tab with collapsible panel AC2: Organized sections: Button Effects, Title Effects, Background Effects AC3: Each toggle reveals additional customization options (progressive disclosure) AC4: All changes trigger immediate preview updates AC5: Reset Effects button resets all effects to defaults AC6: Summary shows count of active effects (e.g., "3 effects active") AC7: Global Animation Intensity control: Subtle, Medium, Bold AC8: Animation intensity affects timing across all animations

constraints.constraint: Use accordion/collapsible UI for organized sections
Progressive disclosure - options appear when toggle enabled
Must count active effects for summary display
Reset must confirm before clearing all effects

interfaces.interface: ALTER TABLE landing_pages ADD COLUMN animation_intensity TEXT DEFAULT 'medium'; -- Values: 'subtle' | 'medium' | 'bold'
EffectsPanel({ data, onUpdate }) - Collapsible accordion with Button/Title/Background sections - Active effects counter - Animation Intensity selector - Reset Effects button with confirmation
function countActiveEffects(data): number // Counts enabled effects: hoverEffect!='none', buttonGlow, buttonGradientBorder, etc.

tests.ideas: - Test accordion expand/collapse - Verify active effects counter updates - Test Reset Effects clears all - Test Animation Intensity affects all animations - Verify progressive disclosure works - Test preview updates in real-time
